name: @visa-master/api
description: The FastAPI backend. Python, not TypeScript: this file exists so turbo's lint/typecheck/test reach it, and every script runs inside apps/api/.venv.

scripts.venv: uv venv --python 3.12 .venv && uv pip install --python .venv -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.typecheck: bash scripts/py.sh python -m compileall -q app scripts api
